PhotoMaster uses @monogrid/gainmap-js 3.7.2 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 MONOGRID).
The libultrahdr subpath provides the JavaScript JPEG/R, XMP, ISO metadata and MPF packager.
The package is used unmodified; it does not introduce a native libultrahdr binary.
Source: https://github.com/MONOGRID/gainmap-js
License: LICENSE-MIT.txt in this directory.
